messages:
Priya (People Ops): Morning @Liam H. quick onboarding logistics Q — can you do a remote I-9 verification on your first day? We can also do in-person at the NY office if you prefer. Need passport OR DL + SSN card.
Liam H.: Hi Priya — remote is better. One thing: Im an international hire with an EAD card. Is that acceptable for I-9? Also, are there special tax forms I should fill out?
Priya (People Ops): EAD is acceptable for Section 2, bring the original to the video check. For taxes: fill the federal W-4 and state tax form (NY IT-2104) — links in the new hire portal.
onboarding-bot: New hire checklist: I-9, Checkr background, W-4, State form, Direct deposit, Benefits (30-day window). Complete by EOD day 1 when possible.
Liam H.: I haven't received the Checkr email yet. Could spam filter be blocking it?
Priya (People Ops): Possibly. I just resent to liam.h@redwood.com and to your personal email. If it doesn't land in 30 min, reply and I'll trigger manual intake.
Dana (Benefits): Heads up on benefits: as an international hire with EAD you can enroll in standard medical/dental/vision. Retirement (401k) enrollment requires SSN; if you don't have one yet, we'll enroll you once SSN is available. Ask during the benefits call.
IT Ops: Laptop provisioning note: we image Macs with Duo MFA and VPN. If you need special software preinstalled (e.g., PyTorch CUDA on GPU laptop), tell us before EOD so we can include it. Tracking and ship ETA will be posted once label is created.
Liam H.: Great, thanks. For the I-9: do I need to upload scans beforehand or just show originals on camera? Also can I record the session on my end?
Priya (People Ops): Please show originals on camera; we do NOT accept pre-uploaded scans for Section 2. We will record the verification for HR records only. Do not record on your end.
Liam H.: Understood. Last question: how do I set up direct deposit?
Priya (People Ops): Direct deposit in payroll portal: https://hr.redwood.com/payroll/setup  use New Hire tab and add bank account or upload a voided check.
Liam H.: Thanks everyone — see you on Monday at 9:30am ET for the I-9.
Priya (People Ops): Scheduled your 9:30am ET slot and added calendar invites for I-9 and Day-1 orientation. We'll follow up if Checkr hasn't completed. :wave:
